answer_1.quote: This includes a range of textediting tasks such as grammatical error correction (GEC) and sentence fusion ... We conduct experiments on GEC and sentence fusion ...
answer_1.outputs: Corrected sentences for grammatical errors and fused sentences for sentence fusion

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models by reporting P/R/F0.5 points on BEA19 Dev data using the ERRANT toolkit and CoNLL14 Test data using M2Scorer. Besides, without additional training, we also report GLEU scores on JFLEG Test data to measure the fluency of CTC-generated texts ... For evaluation, we report two metrics, i.e., Exact Match (EM), which measures the percentage of exactly correct predictions, and SARI, which computes the averaged F1 scores of the inserted, kept, and deleted n-grams.
